verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs clearly cover Undo Send: you can retract a message right after sending, with a configurable cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds. Nothing in the pack documents scheduling an email to send later. Snooze only resurfaces received mail, the offline Outbox sends on reconnect, and Gemini's 'Schedule' proposes meeting times, so none of these count as scheduled sending. Missing for 10: a documented schedule-send capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Next to "Undo Send," select a Send cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds.
Right after you send a message, you can retract it
If you decide you don't want to send an email, you have a short time after to cancel it.
